title: Sore Ike! Anpanman
description:
One night, a Star of Life falls down the chimney of a bakery nestled deep in the forest, causing the dough in the oven to come to life. The dough becomes Anpanman, a superhero made of anpan (a sweet roll with bean jam filling). Together with his friends, Anpanman fights his rival Baikinman and helps the malnourished.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Ojarumaru
description:
In the Heian era, around 1000 years ago, a young boy of noble family named Ojarumaru is bored with his life of privilege. Meanwhile, three demons steal the power-stick of Enma, king of demons, and then lose it. Ojarumaru finds it, and uses it to transport himself to the present time. Here, he is befriended by a young boy named Kazuma, and becomes a member of his family. As time goes on, Ojarumaru makes many new friends, while dodging the comedic efforts of the three demons, Akane, Kisuke, and Aobee, as they try to recover the stick.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Chibi Maruko-chan (1995)
description:
Momoko Sakura is an elementary school student who likes popular idol Momoe Yamaguchi and mangas. She is often called "Chibi Maruko-chan" due to her young age and small size. She lives together with her parents, her grandparents and her elder sister in a little town. In school, she has many friends with whom she studies and plays together everyday, including her close pal, Tama-chan; the student committee members, Maruo-kun and Migiwa-san; and the B-class trio: 'little master' Hanawa-kun, Hamaji-Bu Taro and Sekiguchi-kun. This is a fun-loving and enjoyable anime that portrays the simple things in life.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Hanakappa
description: Story about Kappa with flowers on their heads.

title: Shiawase Haitatsu Taneko
description:
The story centers around a cat who answers people's wishes and delivers happiness. ("Tane" and "neko" are the Japanese words for "seed" and "cat," respectively.)

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Shimajirou no Wow!
description: Fourth season of the Shimajirou children's television series.

title: BONOBONO (2016)
description: A new adaptation of the adventures of three forest friends - a raccoon, a squirrel and a sea otter.

title: PazuDora
description:
The story is set in modern day Japan following the growth of the protagonist Taiga Akashi, an elementary school kid who wants to be a professional gamer someday.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Mori no Ratio
description: Ratio is a girl living in a ice world with his hairy friend Jammon, she will learn various things from the spirits and the people she encounters in every episode.

Short stories capturing the bittersweet and tender moments of everyday family life, made for Marukome Co., Ltd. a miso soup paste manufacturer.

title: ANI x PARA: Anata no Hero wa Dare desu ka
description:
“ANIMATION × PARALYMPIC: Who Is Your Hero?” is a special series featuring fictional Paralympic athletes depicted in world-renowned Japanese animation. The project aims to introduce new Paralympic sports heroes through attractive characters and stories that will be created by the collaboration of famous comic creators and animation film directors. The series will increase the number of featured sports by 2020.

An episode animated by Kyoto Animation was scheduled to be broadcast in August 2019, but was later announced to be cancelled after it was determined production could not be completed in time for the 2020 Paralympic Games due to a tragic arson attack on the studio.

title: Gaina Tamager
description:
Anime short centering on a boy named Tarou as he transforms into the hero Gainaman.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Origami Ninja Koyan @ KinTele
description: Koyan, the Origami Ninja, came to Earth from his planet Origamio to find the magical stone "Hapiton" that has the ability to make people happy. On the way, he was joined by childhood friend Namin anda new friend Lublin. One day, a villain called Evilrun appeared. Evilrun has a black hole in her stomach and tries to inhale anything. Every time an event happens, Evilrun gets in the way of Koyan and friends. But what Evilrun's aim is remains a mystery...

title: Kana Kana Kazoku
description: An original anime series created in cooperation with Kanagawa Prefecture.

title: Shikaruneko
description:
The official Twitter account for manga creator agency wwwaap's Shikaruneko (Angry Cat) character announced on January 5 that the character is inspiring a mini-anime. The anime will premiere this spring on TV Tokyo.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Wu Shang Shen Di 2
description: The second season of Wu Shang Shen Di.

title: Ni Tian Zhizun
description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

title: Zhe Tian
description:
The story took the nine dragons and the coffin as an introduction and brought out a huge world of primeval ages. Climbing the sky road, and singing songs, to see how Ye Fan shrouding the heavens.

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Ninjala
description:
The year is 20XX. The ninja, who once forged the history of Japan, were scattered across the country during the Meiji Restoration. As these ninja mingled with the other clans, their bloodline thinned, and they gradually faded from sight. The descendants of these ninja clans, seeking to preserve their heritage, formed the WNA (World Ninja Association) in the hope of carrying on their legacy.

And so it was that the WNA succeeded in developing Ninja-Gum, an art which could summon forth the strength of the Shinobi. And yet creating the most powerful Ninja-Gum requires the strongest of ninja DNA. So it was that the Ninjala Tournament was held, that the mightiest of all ninjas could be found...

(Source: Official Game website)

title: Girigiri Warukunai Watame
description:
A series of comedic YouTube shorts airing every Friday on Watame's YouTube channel.

Notes:
- Episodes 1-21 (Series 1) were originally released in a vertical format, later rereleased widescreen in 8 compilation videos.
- Contains special episode "Best Girl？！スペシャル回！！！"

title: Wo Cong Zhu Tian Wan Jie Guilai
description:
After three years in jail, he will emerge with the seven strongest bloodlines under heaven, twelve peak professional skills, thirty-six sets of supreme martial arts, seventy-two strongest mystical techniques, and 108 top-level chaos mantras! But with his maxed out martial powers, it turns out his spirit animal is a pig?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Koguma no Yuugo
description: Short clips featuring Yugo that are uploaded on Tomoyasu Murata's YouTube channel.

title: NoriPro Anime
description:
Unveiling NoriPro's VTuber 3D animation NoriPro Anime!

Animation, voice acting, and scenario are all completely created from scratch!

(Source: Tsukudani Norio via Twitter, translated)

title: Wushen Zhuzai: Da Wei Pian
description: The second season of Wushen Zhuzai.

title: Tom to Jerry Gokko
description:
To celebrate "Cheese Day," (November 11 in Japan), Cartoon Network Japan debuted an anime spin on Tom and Jerry that combines the fast-paced humor of the original with a cute, "pop" worldview. The pair are joined by the diaper-wearing Tuffy Mouse, another recurring character from the classic cartoon.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Lian Qi Shiwan Nian
description: One hundred thousand years ago, he was the founding disciple of the Tianlan Sect, his master ascended to the top, and he was refining Qi. Ninety thousand years ago, his martial nephew ascended, and he was refining Qi. Fifty thousand years ago, the old dog who was the gatekeeper of Tianlanzong also ascended, and he was still refining Qi. Thirty thousand years ago, the old tree at the foot of the mountain also became a demon, and he was still refining Qi before he could pass the catastrophe. Ten thousand years ago, Zhang Wuji, the 9872nd generation disciple of Tianlanzong, also ascended, and Xu Yang silently refined Qi. He retreated for 10,000 years, and finally, he broke through the 9999th floor of the Qi refining period! Ten thousand years later, he broke through and came out!

title: Tunshi Xingkong 4
description:
The fourth season of Tunshi Xingkong.

Note: Episodes 86 to 260.

title: Cheng Ye Xiao He
description:
In the game, the server's top swordsman, Xiao Wujin, and the most wanted female outlaw, Tao Zhiyaoyao, first crossed paths as rivals. In real life, campus heartthrob Xiao He of Dongchuan University and freshman Shen Xin met through a collegiate esports tournament and quickly grew close. Together with their friend Yang Yao, they formed a team and fought their way through every challenge, determined to claim the championship. Along the way, Xiao He and Shen Xin healed and inspired one another, moving forward hand in hand in pursuit of their dreams. With a little help from their friends Yang Yao and Xiang Nan, what kind of romance will blossom between them?

(Source: iQ)

title: Zichuan 2
description:
To clear suspicion, words are the weakest defense. True power speaks for itself! General Zichuan Xiu, who once single-handedly executed a traitor of the Zichuan clan within the Demon Clan's stronghold, has risen to command hundreds of thousands of allied troops in the Far East. Supported by the Guardian Elders of the Sacred Temple, this warrior now ascends as the new sovereign of the Eastern lands: The Bright King is crowned!

(Source: WeTV)

title: Taiko no Tatsujin (2022)
description: Taiko lover Kotarou from Taiko Village travels to Omiko City with his partner Don-chan in order to spread the greatness of Taiko across the world.

title: Nandemo Bakukai! Koyori-chan
description: A series of shorts starring Hakui Koyori that ends with a bang!

title: Chickip Dancers 3rd Season
description: The third season of Chickip Dancers.

title: Rokurou no Daibouken
description: One day, twelve amulets that protect the world are shattered. By whom? While the curse of shattered pieces is spreading to people around the world, for some reason there is only one person who is not under the curse. That is Rokuro. Rokuro sets on a journey with his big brother Goro and younger sister Nanako to save their family and eventually the world. With a magic brush that he got from a hermit, Rokuro's great adventure starts!

title: Aikatsu Academy! Animation PVs
description:
Animated promotional videos for the Aikatsu franchise's virtual YouTuber project, Aikatsu Academy! posted on the Streaming Club's YouTube channel.

1) Mankai! Helianthe / 満開！エリオント (16 July 2024)
2) HAPPY REFLECTION (23 November 2024)

title: Ling Wu Dalu
description:
Lingwu Continent is a world where spiritual power and martial spirit coexist. A spiritual cultivator can move mountains and rivers with a thought, and a martial artist can tear the world apart with bare hands. Chen Tian, ​​a former genius in Xingchen Town, lost his martial spirit and dried up his spiritual sea after he turned ten.

Since then, he has become a waste of his family and has been looked down upon by others. In a life-and-death struggle, Chen Tian fell off a cliff and mistakenly entered the formation arranged by the ancient sword emperor. Under the influence of the power of the heavenly book, he awakened his spiritual and martial dual cultivation physique. At the same time, he also obtained a strange memory and a mysterious storage ring.

From then on, he rose from adversity, broke through the reincarnation of the Heavenly Dao Palm, and finally crossed the shackles of the emperor's calamity and aspired to become the champion of Lingwu Continent!

(Source: iQIYI)

title: Rilakkuma
description:
Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time.

It's a moment that will make your heart feel lighter and lighter. No matter where you are or what you're doing, Rilakkuma will be by your side. An exciting new story begins! Experience the stress-free world of Rilakkuma, the relaxed bear who makes being lazy look effortless!

(Source: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, translated)

title: Nui Story 2
description: Second season of Nui Story.

title: Nitian Xie Shen: Nian Fan
description:
The 2nd season of Nitian Xie Shen.

Note: Includes episodes 31-82.

title: Dushi Gu Xian Yi
description: Ye Bufan, a junior student, tried to scam a car to raise medical expenses for his mother. Unexpectedly, he encountered a female driver who did not play by the rules. After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he mastered medical skills, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beautiful women.

title: MILGRAM Third Season
description:
Third season of the interactive collaborative multimedia music project between DECO*27 and Takuya Yamanaka.

The list of released videos included in this entry are as follows:
1) Yuno - Life (ユノ - ライフ), June 18, 2025.
2) Futa - The Appare March (フータ - 天晴行進曲), Aug 20, 2025.
3) Muu - Pain (ムウ - ペイン), Oct 22, 2025.
4) Kazui - Camouflage (カズイ - カモフラージュ), Mar 18, 2026.
5) Amane - Non-Demonium (アマネ - なんでもにうむ), May 20, 2026.
6) Mikoto - Requiem (ミコト - レクイエム), July 15, 2026.

title: AOTU Shijie Reborn
description:
The Creator of Aotu World is a reckless God who created a universe full of inequality, but also gave the people a chance to change their destiny- Just participate in the "Aotu Tournament" and utilize the "Special Abilities" granted by the system. Pass rounds of cruel tests and strive for the ultimate victory! Now, the tournament, which has been suspended for 100 years, has been reopened.

Our protagonist, King, decides to enter the tournament in order to change the fate of his planet, Dengru, and find his sister...

title: Ugoku! Neko Mukashi Banashi
description:
What if cats appeared in that story…? When beloved old tales and fairy stories are joined by cats, a surreal and heartwarming new adventure begins…!? Tabby cats, orange cats, calico cats, and white cats— a delightful mix of feline friends woven into timeless stories is sure to soothe the hearts of all humanity! A charming cat comedy is about to unfold!

(Source: AniOne Asia)

title: Gekkan! Nanmono Anime
description:
A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects.

The shorts will stream monthly on various social media services such as Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, as well as on ABEMA.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title: GO! GO! TOKYO MER: Kinkyuujitai to Tatakau Nakama-tachi
description:
The live-action Tokyo MER: Hashiru Kinkyuukyuumeishitsu medical drama series got a short anime to commemorate the series' movie announcement. It portrays the characters as animals.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Shiguang Dailiren III
description: The third season of Shiguang Dailiren.

title: Chibi Godzilla no Gyakushuu 3
description: Sequel to Chibi Godzilla no Gyakushuu 2.

title: Koala Enikki
description:
The manga is about Koala who writes about daily life, whether it's good or bad, happy or sad, Koala treats every day as a precious day. Koala believes that today is a good day, and tomorrow will be a good day too.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Shixiong A Shixiong Nian Fan 2
description: The fourth season of Shixiong A Shixiong.

title: Onaka ga Guuguu Island
description:
This is Guuguu Island, a magical island where the Yakiniku King menu items live. Meat, vegetables, mulberries, sweets... there's all kinds of delicious food! Calvin the apprentice galbi has a dream to become "Yakiniku King's most popular menu item"! To achieve that, he is happily flying around the universe with his adorable friends. Will Calvin and his friends be able to become Yakiniku King's most popular menu items? Aim for a delicious serving! Aim for a delicious Yakiniku King!

(Source: YouTube, translated)

title: Dou Po Cangqiong: Nian Fan 4
description:
The eighth season of Dou Po Cangqiong.

Note: Episodes 158 to 219.

title: Dungeons & Television
description:
Once upon a time, when television broadcasting itself was an adventure.

The invention of the television has made it possible to broadcast any event, however it is still an era where swords and sorcery abound. It has come for the cameras to turn their lens towards the darkness of dungeons, previously only known to adventurers.

Fighting countless monsters and constant equipment problems, the camera-wielding adventurers continued on, hoping to broadcast the first live dungeon capture. What may await them ahead?

(Source: Official Youtube channel)

title: Da Zhu Zai 2
description:
Second season of Da Zhuzai.

Note: Includes Episodes 53 - 104.

title: Wanmei Shijie 6
description: The sixth season of Wanmei Shijie. (Episode 235-286)

title: Yi Nian Yongheng 4
description: The fourth and final season of Yi Nian Yongheng.

title: Princess Catch! Tiniping
description: On the way to an important gathering by train, the Princess Teeniepings suddenly disappeared without a trace! To make matters even more mysterious, a Legend Teenieping appears in a mirror before Romi. Together with the new Royal Teeniepings, a grand mission begins to catch the Princess Teeniepings!

title: Inpuru-kun no Sonzai Shinai Oshigoto
description: The anime is based on temp agency Improve's mascot Inpuru-kun. It centers on Inpuru-kun taking on absurd temp jobs.

title: Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan Di Wu Ji
description: Fifth season of Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan.

title: Odekake Kozame Season 2
description: Second season of Odekake Kozame.

title: Metal Cardbot W
description:
Shining friendship and strong claws! Metal Cardbot W!

After the Speranza incident, humans and Metal Cardbots began to coexist on Earth. Jun, a boy chosen by the Metal Breath, and his partner Blue Cop discovered a way for humans and Metal Cardbots to coexist. Then one day, a "Wild Cardbot" appears, holding a 60 million year secret.

Now, a new encounter begins to shake the world.

(Source: Metal Cardbot Wiki)

title: mofusand
description:
Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit.
A little clumsy and always taking things at their own cozy pace,
but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow —
is filled with unexpected little mishaps and sweet adventures.

A sunny warm spot in the park, the sparkle of the sea,
steam rising from freshly roasted sweet potatoes,
the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall…
These small everyday moments fill their world with warmth and delight.

You can’t help but smile and think, “So true!”
A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments.

(Source: QTORY Channel)

title: Enter the Garden
description: Three-part anthology series created by Azuki and Dentsu with creative producer, Gorou Taniguchi.

title: Candy Caries
description:
Ame is a child who loves sweets, and the tooth decay that lives in her mouth called Caries. Caries lives a carefree life inside Ame's mouth and even calls her "Mama", and Ame's body is always at Caries' mercy.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title: Zhu Xian Final
description: The final season of Zhu Xian.

title: Cang Yuan Tu 3
description: The third season of Cang Yuan Tu.

title: Yi Zhan Cangqiong
description:
In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.

(Source: Youku)

title: Wangu Zhizun: Li Yunxiao Zhuan
description:
Gu Feiyang, the third strongest warrior on the Tianwu Continent and the Martial Emperor Pojun, was bound by the world's rules, his cultivation stuck at the Nine Heavens Martial Emperor realm for many years, unable to break through. To escape this predicament, he used the affections of Qu Hongyan, the mistress of the Shenxiao Palace, to orchestrate a grand scheme, sacrificing extraterrestrial demonic energy to reincarnate and cultivate anew.

In his reincarnation, he was named Li Yunxiao, a 15-year-old boy from the Tianshui Kingdom and the eldest grandson of the Li family of the Marshal's Mansion. At this time, Tianshui was beset by powerful enemies invading from the outside and princes vying for the throne from within, making the Li family, who held military power, the center of a vortex of crisis. Faced with the power struggles of everyone, Li Yunxiao stood at a higher level, calmly breaking through the impasse. He deeply understood that in this world where martial arts reign supreme, all power ultimately came from within, and his goal remained singular: to complete the scheme laid out in his previous life and build a foundation for the Divine Realm.

title: Sousou no Frieren: ●● no Mahou Part 3
description:
A third batch of the ●● no Mahou shorts released alongside the airing of the TV anime's second season, starting with #18. Posted on the official YouTube account of TOHO animation, Frieren Twitter, and Frieren TikTok account.

Includes:
• Mita Mono wo Kousoku Suru Mahou (見た者を拘束する魔法), released Jan 19, 2026.
• Doushin ni Kaeru Mahou (童心に還る魔法), released Feb 2, 2026.
• Kokoro to Karada ga Irekawaru Mahou (心と体が入れ替わる魔法), released Feb 17, 2026.
• Osentaku no Mahou (お洗濯の魔法), released Mar 2, 2026.
• Kangaeteiru Koto wo Itte Shimau Mahou Sono Ni (考えていることを言ってしまう魔法その2), released Mar 16, 2026.
• Akogare ni Hitareru Mahou (憧れにひたれる魔法), released on May 22, 2026.

title: Onegai AiPri
description:
The latest entry in the Pretty Series franchise and a new chapter in the AiPri series.

Note: Relations are provisional and will be updated when more info is announced.

title: Kumarba Season 3
description: Third season of Kumarba.

title: Onee-chan Gokko
description:
In the distant future, on the outskirts left behind by the rapid concentration of advanced science and technology in urban areas, lies a remote mountain village known as Kagami Village.
“Behave yourself, or a Double will come for you.”
Such old folklore still lingers in this village.

Akane Higure, a middle school student living in Kagami Village, has been eagerly awaiting the return of her older sister, Sui Higure, who is finally being discharged from the hospital after a year.
However, not long after her sister comes home, Akane receives a single phone call.

“The girl at home with you… isn’t your sister.”

title: Dao Yao Xing
description:
Forced into a marriage of convenience based on mutual benefit, Jiang Yuan, an assassin from the Tai Xuan Tower, and Shao Yue, the holy maiden of the Jiu Xuan Sect, are ordered to marry. On their wedding night, they attempt an assassination, only to discover they are both immortal. To obtain the Demon-Suppressing Bell and the Demon-Controlling Bell, secret treasures of each other's sects, they transform from mortal enemies into a facade of marriage, engaging in a charade of mutual deception. However, neither is aware that the other is also an alien survivor whose home was destroyed by the "Void." This destined couple forms an alliance amidst suspicion and testing, not only searching for the treasures transformed from a lost spaceship but also confronting the ever-watchful cultivation world, seeking hope to defeat the "Void" amidst perilous circumstances.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Everything is even cuter when you're with a friend! ♪

Please look forward to more heartwarming and humorous stories that will leave you feeling cozy and healed by all the cute PetitCure. ♡

(Source: Official Website)

title: Li Xiongmao
description:
Adapted from a novel by Wen Zhou, this story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by demons who is sent by his master to leave Black-White Mountain and kill the three enemies responsible for the demons’ downfall. As he searches for the truth, he gradually unravels the mysteries behind the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and his own destiny.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

description: A sequel to Transformers: Wild King.

title: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan
description:
Orphan Qin Yu was specially admitted to the top cultivation academy, Dongda Martial Academy. Behind the city's calm, a demonic threat quietly approached. Qin Yu vowed to lead his fellow disciples to resist the invading demons.

(Source: Youku)

title: Azarashi no Eru Aru
description:
Two seals, Eru and Aru, spend their days together in a gentle and warm atmosphere. They play at home, relax watching TV, and sometimes get tired from playing and fall asleep.

(Source: U-NEXT, translated)

title: Jueshi Zhan Hun 2
description:
In the Canglan Continent, strength is determined by martial spirits. Qin Nan, the young master of the Qin family, was originally a useless soul, suffering endless scorn. By chance, he awakened the soul of an ancient war god, thus defying fate. He swept through sect geniuses, overcame powerful enemies and obstacles, encountered a soulmate, used his battle spirit to break all laws, and forged a legend with his blood. From a humble young master, he rose through the ranks to become an invincible supreme celestial being who shakes the nine realms.

(Source: IQIYI, translated)

title: Jiaonang Jihua: Qiji
description:
"Capsules Project" is a collection of domestically produced animated short films created by a professional team with mature animation production experience. With the creative theme of "extreme emotion + independent theme," it does not restrict the creative form, exploring the possibilities of animation together with the team. The aim is to collaboratively create original short films with diverse styles and characteristics, and to help Chinese animators reach the world stage. "Miracle" represents transcending conventions and breaking through limitations to achieve extraordinary success, often accompanied by a sense of mystery that inspires awe and curiosity. What miracles will occur in these 10 stories?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

description:
In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...

(Source: iQ)

title: Di Ling Ai: Shui Xin Chan
description:
After the great war, chaos rose from the abyss, and darkness engulfed the earth like a tidal wave… Dimo ​​and the Water Emperor traveled to Rome to find a way to seal it, but chaos had already dragged the Ice Emperor and Yanhu into the abyss… A mysterious Tarot messenger appeared… The Ship King's backlash grew stronger, and Princess Du framed the Spirit Emperor but accidentally awakened the fairy in the icy cage. The group finally discovered the weakness of chaos… Can they work together to seal chaos? Can love and faith write a new myth?

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai Season 4
description: The fourth season of Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai.

title: Zhangmen Didiao Dian
description:
As heavy snow blanketed the gates, demonic cultivators launched a surprise attack, slaughtering the entire Mo Sect. The young Lu Chaoge lost his closest relatives in the tragedy. Facing certain death, he awakened to a system that defied the heavens, narrowly escaping death through water-elemental spiritual awakening, and vowed to purge the world of demons and evil. After a decade of seclusion and arduous cultivation, he remained stuck at the Initial Realm, unable to make any progress. One day, a chance opportunity reactivated the system. He set out from the mountain with his younger sister, Lu Dongli, in search of spiritual herbs to break through his cultivation barrier. Along the way, he ingeniously solved a challenge posed by a strange beast, defied the heavens to summon nine Celestial Decrees to awaken his spiritual power, and broke through five cultivation realms in succession. He even faced down a challenge from a prodigy of the Sword Sect. The once-useless sect master thus began a powerful comeback.

(Source: Yuewen, translated)

title: Caishen Dou Zhanlong
description:
Taoist Cui accidentally released the treasure-gathering golden toad in order to read the heavenly book. The golden toad coveted the prosperity of the human world and reincarnated as a human, Dou Zhanlong. In order to avoid the heavenly calamity, the golden toad tore the three souls and seven spirits in Dou Zhanlong's spiritual cavity, creating nine clones, which fell into nine places respectively. The nine Dou Zhanlongs were in different parallel time and space, and each death gave rise to a new clone. They experienced "nine deaths and thirteen disasters" in total. Our story starts with the first Dou Zhanlong.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Taigu Shen Zun
description:
The supreme prince of the Spirit Realm was tragically murdered after being plotted against, and reborn into the mortal world as a lowly servant! Possessing an unparalleled creation elixir and heaven-defying cultivation techniques, he overturns the entire martial arts world with only a rusty sword. His dual martial souls awaken simultaneously, refining all spirits and comprehending the dual paths of divine soul cultivation. He traverses the Heavenly Demon Treasury, the Dragon Transformation Realm, and ancient ruins, acquiring supreme treasures such as the Demon Lord Armor and the Great Desolate Mirror. Various prodigies, sect parasites, and extraterrestrial evil races come to his death, but he crushes them all with a single sword strike! He subdues a dragon soul and a spirit dog, protects his beloved friends and family, surpasses Martial Kings, breaks through Martial Emperors, and ascends to Martial Venerable status. He confronts his two archenemies, Long Zhetian and Nangong Lingtian, tearing apart the long-buried conspiracy of ancient dark turmoil.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
